_about: Company expansion test (leadlist.expand) on the Dulcy Manufacturing sample (recSampleTest0001). Target 300 usable companies (Tier 1 + Tier 2), batches of 2,500 max. About 320 DiscoLike credits. Creates a new Google Sheet (in scale@dulcy.io's Drive) and writes one batch at a time.
name: [Dulcy] Manufacturing (engine test)

filters.icp_prompt: Product manufacturers in the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom that make and distribute physical consumer or commercial goods through retailers, dealers, distributors, or stores, and could benefit from reaching those buyers directly
filters.icp_text: Manufacturers of physical consumer or commercial goods that design, produce, and distribute branded products through wholesale and retail channels, including retailers, dealers, distributors, stockists, and stores.
